messages:
Riley (marketing): Quick ask for the launch post and webinar: can eng-runtime produce a small verified bench pack (fp16 + int8), embedding + gen p50/p95, and cold vs warmed profiles? Need a 1-page runbook and artifacts zip.

Luis (marketing): Also need a single-slide summary table and a clear pass/fail against these demo targets: gen median <= 280ms (<=64 tokens), embed p50 <= 40ms.

bench-bot: queued job 5017 - ingesting payloads from drive:/marketing/launch/payloads_mini.jsonl

Nora (eng-runtime): We can handle this. Clarify: do you want batch sizes [1] only for slide-friendly numbers, or include batch=2 for throughput notes? And do we include a small fallback 3B?

Riley (marketing): Batch=1 only for the slide. Include the 3B fallback artifact (optional) but mark it separate. Also include a 12% random holdout set for SRE validation. No cherry-picking.

Dev (eng-runtime): Noted. We'll run on staging dedicated nodes, variants: fp16, int8-fastkernel. Warm runs = 6 synthetic warmups; cold runs = strict cold. Deliverables: runs/*.csv (per-request), summary.csv (p50/p95/p99), manifest.txt (with RNG seed), runbook.md, traces.tar.gz. ETA: tomorrow morning.

Riley (marketing): ETA works. Please call out which kernel/version for int8 in the README.

bench-bot: job 5017 -> ingest complete: 42 payloads, artifacts staged at /artifacts/5017

Dev (eng-runtime): Smoke done. Short excerpt of runs/warm_int8.csv:

```
req_id,variant,warmup,total_ms,model_ms,tokens
q1,int8,true,210,195,24
q2,fp16,false,460,445,56
q3,int8,false,980,965,1200
```

Nora (eng-runtime): We'll include the slide-ready CSV that maps model, variant, median_gen_ms, median_embed_ms, cold_p95_ms, pass_fail. We'll flag any FAILs. If variance high on p95 we'll annotate with notes and include rerun artifacts.

Luis (marketing): When you upload zip, ping #marketing and paste the one-line checklist: artifacts present, manifest with seed, pass/fail table, runbook included. We'll hold final copy until we verify the 12% holdout manifest.

Riley (marketing): Thanks — we'll coordinate slide copy after verification. :thumbsup:
